layout: Original generated raster pixels, four equal columns and rows. First fourteen cells map to upgrades; final two cells reserved.

viper.name: viper
viper.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI raster upgrade-icon atlas for a premium top-down sci-fi aircraft game. Exactly FOUR columns by FOUR rows, sixteen equal square cells, evenly spaced full grid, no labels, letters, numbers, borders, watermark or text. Each cell is a distinct centered hand-painted detailed game skill illustration with a clean readable silhouette, polished metal and luminous energy shading, dark navy background, generous inset margin, consistent contrast and soft vignette within each cell. Not vector glyphs, no simplistic geometric diagrams. Aircraft theme: viper. In strict row-major order from top left, the sixteen subjects are: 1: expanded squadron of blue decoy flares; 2: blue decoy capturing heat into a mana cell; 3: decoy releasing a concentric blue countershock; 4: decoy flares opening to a powerful retaliatory gun; 5: blue engine with extended burning trail; 6: overcharged blue gun coils; 7: two bouncing blue bullets ricocheting between targets; 8: unstoppable armored blue afterburner; 9: crosshair exposing a cracked armor weak point; 10: paired small blue guided missiles; 11: predator radar detecting a fleeing target; 12: execution crosshair with a piercing blue missile; 13: large cluster of many blue missiles; 14: apocalyptic blue missile rain with burning critical target; 15: spare abstract energy core matching the aircraft; 16: spare wing insignia matching the aircraft. Keep every illustration fully contained in its own equal cell; make the first fourteen images clearly different and match each description.
